product.title: Parasailing in Key West at Smathers Beach

description.text: Take in rare birds–eye views of Key West on a parasailing adventure over Smathers Beach. With a range of departure times offered throughout the day, this tour is a popular, flexible choice for families. Your guide, who ensures that the small group has a personalized experience, takes photos and videos available for purchase after the trip.Soar over the coastal landscapes of Key West, Florida Keep your eyes peeled for wildlife while in the air Photos and videos of your flight are available to purchase A small group means less time to wait before your flight Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
